title: Story 1.4 M1: primary-host baseline capture and pre-mutation lifecycle inspection
summary: Read-only observation of the PRIMARY portability host (the always-on devbox VM): machine-readable secret-free host baseline with per-fact provenance (AC-4), the pair-representativeness record including the observed-not-selected cachyos candidate, and the pre-mutation lifecycle inspection via the canonical installation's own status/verify/adopt-inspect JSON with a truthful ambiguity verdict (AC-5). No lifecycle mutation, no git writes, evidence-only output into the story worktree.
